name: fitd-builder
description: Builds foot-in-the-door offers two ways: contextualize an existing Extendly menu offer to a niche (Expert Secrets hook + story, hydrated OfferIQ 7 pillars, ad/VSL/landing copy), or build a new offer from scratch against the OfferIQ 7-pillar standard as a markdown submission packet.
